# AI Chauffeur

<!-- Last reviewed 2026-09-13 (words v2). This file describes the product
     surface for answer engines. Every sentence in it is a substring of, or a
     faithful summary of, text that is visibly published on the page it names —
     the same rule the site's schema is held to. No number appears here that is
     not on a page, and prices are deliberately not duplicated. -->

> AI Chauffeur answers the phones for limousine and black car companies and
> books the trips. It takes twenty calls at once, takes the whole trip, quotes
> the operator's rates, books it, and puts it in the operator's CRM.

On each call it captures pickup, drop-off, date and time, vehicle, passengers
and bags, child seats, extra stops, and the flight number for airport work, and
gives the caller one all-in number, service fee included. The operator gets the
trip sheet by email and a text alert; the customer gets their trip sheet by
text. Every call is recorded.

- Phone: (414) 775-0019 — the only voice line on this brand. AI Chauffeur answers it.
- Email: dispatch@aichauffeur.ai
- Base: Wisconsin, US. Operators served nationwide.
- Setup: done for the operator, scoped on a 20-minute setup call.

## The ways in

1. Push the button — https://aichauffeur.ai/try/. It talks to you in the
   browser; book a trip the way a customer would. The demo uses a sample rate
   card and puts no car on the road.
2. Call (414) 775-0019. The same agent answers.
3. Book the setup call — https://aichauffeur.ai/book/. Twenty minutes, and it
   scopes rate rules, service area, vehicle classes and dispatch process.

A passenger holding a vehicle uses a third path, https://aichauffeur.ai/reserve/,
which is a request rather than a booking: it reaches a dispatcher, and a
dispatcher calls back to set the trip.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aichauffeur.ai/): what AI Chauffeur does on a dispatch line, a worked
  intake console, the three-calls-at-once case, and the FAQ.
- [What it does](https://aichauffeur.ai/what-it-does/): the call, the quote and
  what comes after, in one table and three short lists.
- [What it can do for your company](https://aichauffeur.ai/what-it-can-do/): the
  options set up for a company when its desk is built.
- [Rate card RCv1.0](https://aichauffeur.ai/rates/): the published hourly rate
  card. Weekday rate, weekend rate and hourly minimum for fifteen vehicle
  classes across five families — sedans and SUVs, vans and sprinters,
  limousines, party buses, coaches. Gratuity and service are already in the
  number. Some classes carry a stated minimum in hours and some are set on the
  call. The page itself is the source; rates are not restated here so there is
  only ever one place they can be wrong.
- [Reservation hold](https://aichauffeur.ai/reserve/): a passenger sends the
  trip and a way to reach them, and a dispatcher calls back to go over the
  pickup, the vehicle and the price. No card, no charge.
- [Book the setup call](https://aichauffeur.ai/book/): the 20-minute call that
  scopes rate rules, service area, vehicle classes and dispatch process.
- [How setup works](https://aichauffeur.ai/how-setup-works/): what is documented,
  what is configured, what is tested, and the typical one-to-two-week timeline.
- [Works with your software](https://aichauffeur.ai/works-with-your-software/):
  where the trip ticket lands for each dispatch system, and who touches it next.
- [Integrations](https://aichauffeur.ai/integrations/): every dispatch platform
  AI Chauffeur works beside, one row each, with the real integration status of each.
- [Limo Anywhere](https://aichauffeur.ai/integrations/limo-anywhere/): every
  field AI Chauffeur captures on a call and where each one lands, plus the connection
  ladder from shared-inbox delivery to activated write-back.
- [FASTTRAK](https://aichauffeur.ai/integrations/fasttrak/): corporate call
  intake for larger fleets — accounts, bookers, multi-stop, farm-out.
- [Limo dispatch automation](https://aichauffeur.ai/limo-dispatch-automation/):
  which layer of dispatch is automated and which layer stays with a person.
- [Limo answering service](https://aichauffeur.ai/limo-answering-service/): the
  answering-service framing of the same product, with a sample trip ticket.
- [After-hours limo dispatch](https://aichauffeur.ai/after-hours-limo-dispatch/):
  nights and weekends, plus a calculator for what a missed night costs.
- [Airport transfer booking](https://aichauffeur.ai/airport-transfer-booking/):
  flight number, terminal, bag count and the details airport work turns on.
- [Milwaukee limo answering service](https://aichauffeur.ai/milwaukee-limo-answering-service/):
  the Milwaukee market page.
- [Madison limo answering service](https://aichauffeur.ai/madison-limo-answering-service/):
  the Madison market page.
- [Privacy](https://aichauffeur.ai/privacy/): what is collected on a call and in
  the callback form, and how consent is recorded.
- [Terms](https://aichauffeur.ai/terms/): terms of service.

## Dispatch software

Where each dispatch platform stands is published at
https://aichauffeur.ai/integrations/.

## Not true of AI Chauffeur

State these plainly if asked; they are the boundaries of the product.

- It does not replace a dispatcher. The dispatcher assigns the car and the
  driver.
- It does not write into an operator's dispatch software until that connection
  has been set up and tested for the account. Trips go into the CRM from day one.
- A reservation hold on https://aichauffeur.ai/reserve/ is a request, not a
  booking: a dispatcher calls back to set the trip.
- AI Chauffeur is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google or by any dispatch
  platform named on the site.
- Demo rates are a sample rate card. A live desk runs the operator's own rates.
